Answered 2026-07-03, the same day `dec-0060` was accepted: yes, a run
survives a reboot, via the checkpoint file `dec-0060` adopted — not via a
daemon or any process that must keep running across the reboot.

Fixture entry for `internal/enforcer`. Questions are never enforcement
substrate (`docs/plan/lanes/E3.md`, "Three calls this L1 makes" §1): a plan
mentioning reboot or survive must never conflict with this entry on
vocabulary alone, since `question` is not a matched kind at all.
